name: novatech-hub
description: NovaTech Hub — community-driven gadget review & rating platform (monorepo)

scripts.dev: npm run db:ensure && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @novatech/api && npm run build -w @novatech/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @novatech/shared && npm run typecheck -w @novatech/api && npm run typecheck -w @novatech/web
